placements.role: Provides available 2.5D heterogeneous packaging that integrates logic dies with HBM.

role_evidence.claim: Samsung announced immediate availability of I-Cube4, a 2.5D packaging technology integrating four HBM dies and one logic die on a silicon interposer.

placements.role: Designs and volume-manufactures high-bandwidth memory for AI accelerators.

role_evidence.claim: Samsung says it began HBM4 mass production and shipped commercial products to customers in February 2026.

business_summary: Samsung Electronics Co., Ltd. is a KOSPI-listed conglomerate whose semiconductor division spans memory, foundry and packaging. For this chain it is unusual in sitting on three links at once, which is also why no single placement describes it: the same issuer is a leading-edge foundry competitor, an advanced-packaging supplier and an HBM manufacturer, and its consolidated financials also carry a large consumer-electronics business that has nothing to do with this chain.

exposure_summary.narrative: Three ACTIVE placements, all VERIFIED from Samsung's own newsroom and results releases: foundry (position 6, heat CROWDED) on first-generation 2nm mass production, advanced-packaging (position 7, heat EMERGING) on I-Cube4 2.5D integration, and hbm-memory (position 8, heat CROWDED at crowdedness 78) on HBM4 commercial shipment in February 2026. It is the broadest exposure in this batch and the most diluted: the placements are real, but they sit inside a group whose revenue is dominated by businesses outside this chain.
